revisions.comment: /* 2026 (with Broad Front) */ Remove Electográfica's source as it does not yet account for the updated full report

/* 2026 (with Broad Front) */ La Séptima just uploaded this. It looks like, indeed, the daily numbers (including the PSOE 29,8%-PP 29,1%-etc. figures) corresponded *just* to the 300 daily interviews (page 8); the seat projection is calculated over a sample size starting on 26 October and ending on 4 November. It also provides further data on Leadership figures and Preferred gov. All daily 300-sample daily figures are obviously definitively excluded now

/* 2026 (with Broad Front) */ Checked some info online, it looks like these daily figures could correspond *just* to the 300 daily tracking polls rather than unique daily estimations calculated from an average of several days (which is what past precedent allows). Only the seat projection here would have a 3,500 sample size. This would explain the sudden daily variations and why % did not exactly align with seats. I'm leaving the seat projection while removing the % figures until further updates
